nodes.title: SG-1 · Bootstrap Go backend with player sessions
nodes.body:
Context: backend/ currently holds only README.md; there is no go.mod or Go source. Desired behavior: a Go module with Chi router, YAML config loader with env overrides, slog logging, GET health endpoint, POST /api/v1/player/session creating an anonymous player with a Secure HttpOnly cookie token, and GET /api/v1/player/me returning the player or 401. Expected result: all of it covered by httptest unit tests that run offline. Why: this is the foundation for later contribution and admin APIs, with no database or external store.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the backend module, when `go test ./...` runs in backend/ with no network, then all tests pass
- Given a valid config YAML, when it is loaded, then env vars override secrets and Git/hosting settings
- Given POST /api/v1/player/session, when called, then a random player ID is returned and a Secure HttpOnly cookie is set
- Given GET /api/v1/player/me, when the cookie is valid it returns 200 with the player, otherwise 401


## Scope
- In scope: backend/ Go module
- In scope: configs example YAML
- In scope: slog logging
- In scope: health endpoint
- In scope: player session and me endpoints
- Out of scope: database or external store
- Out of scope: contribution, world, admin APIs
- Out of scope: frontend, game, worker
- Preserve: backend/README.md


## Technical constraints
- Go with Chi router
- HMAC secret from config verifies tokens
- No database or external store
- Tests must not use the network


## Definition of done
- All requirements delivered and unit tests pass offline


## Non-functional requirements
- Secrets never logged


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Backend module with YAML config, slog logging and health endpoint
nodes.body:
Context: no Go module exists in backend/. Desired behavior: backend/go.mod (Chi, yaml.v3), configs/config.example.yaml, a loader applying env overrides for token secret and Git/hosting settings, slog JSON logger, and a Chi router exposing GET /healthz. Expected result: the server can be constructed from a config and answers health checks. Why: every later endpoint needs config and routing.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given configs/config.example.yaml, when loaded, then server address, auth and git fields are populated
- Given env STORYFORGE_TOKEN_SECRET and STORYFORGE_GIT_TOKEN, when loading, then they override YAML values
- Given GET /healthz, when called, then status 200 and JSON {"status":"ok"} are returned
- Given a config missing auth.token_secret, when loaded, then an error is returned


## Scope
- In scope: config package
- In scope: example config
- In scope: router and health
- In scope: main entrypoint
- Out of scope: player endpoints


## Technical constraints
- gopkg.in/yaml.v3 and github.com/go-chi/chi/v5
- stdlib log/slog


## Definition of done
- Config, logger and health implemented


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Anonymous player session creation with HMAC token cookie
nodes.body:
Context: no player code exists. Desired behavior: a token package that signs and verifies tokens as base64url(playerID.issuedUnix).base64url(HMAC-SHA256) using the config secret, and a handler that creates a random 128-bit hex player ID and sets a cookie. Expected result: response JSON contains the player ID and the cookie is HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/. Why: players need identity without accounts.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given POST /api/v1/player/session, when called, then status 201 and body contains a 32-char hex id
- Given the response, when inspecting Set-Cookie, then HttpOnly, Secure and Path=/ are set with Max-Age from config ttl
- Given two calls, when compared, then the player IDs differ
- Given a token signed with the secret, when verified, then the player ID is returned


## Scope
- In scope: player token sign/verify
- In scope: session handler
- In scope: route registration
- Out of scope: me endpoint
- Out of scope: persistence
- Preserve: health endpoint


## Technical constraints
- crypto/hmac sha256 with hmac.Equal
- no storage


## Dependencies
- R1


## Definition of done
- Session endpoint returns cookie


## Non-functional requirements
- Constant-time signature comparison


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Player me endpoint validating session cookie
nodes.body:
Context: tokens are issued by the session endpoint. Desired behavior: GET /api/v1/player/me reads the cookie, verifies HMAC and expiry, and returns the player JSON, or 401 JSON error for missing, tampered, malformed or expired tokens. Expected result: deterministic auth behavior. Why: later APIs reuse the same check.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a valid cookie, when GET /api/v1/player/me, then 200 and {"id":<playerID>}
- Given no cookie, when requested, then 401
- Given a token with altered signature or signed with another secret, when requested, then 401
- Given an expired token, when requested, then 401


## Scope
- In scope: me handler
- In scope: expiry check using injected clock
- Out of scope: contributions listing
- Preserve: session endpoint behavior


## Technical constraints
- clock injected for testability


## Dependencies
- R2


## Definition of done
- Me endpoint returns 200 or 401 correctly


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Create module github.com/worldseed/storyforge/backend with go 1.22 requiring github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 and gopkg.in/yaml.v3
steps.expected: go.mod exists; `go mod tidy` resolves deps

steps.action: Add keys server.addr (":8080"), auth.token_secret ("change-me-32-bytes-minimum"), auth.cookie_name ("sf_session"), auth.token_ttl ("720h"), auth.cookie_secure (true), git.remote_url, git.branch ("main"), git.bot_name, git.bot_email, git.token, hosting.provider, hosting.base_url
steps.expected: File parses as YAML with all listed keys

steps.action: Define Config structs with yaml tags (TokenTTL as time.Duration parsed from string). Implement LoadFS(fsys fs.FS, name string, getenv func(string) string) (*Config, error): read file, yaml.Unmarshal, then override from env STORYFORGE_ADDR, STORYFORGE_TOKEN_SECRET, STORYFORGE_GIT_REMOTE_URL, STORYFORGE_GIT_TOKEN, STORYFORGE_HOSTING_PROVIDER, STORYFORGE_HOSTING_BASE_URL when non-empty; default cookie_name to sf_session and ttl to 720h; return error if token_secret is empty. Implement Load(path string) that calls LoadFS(os.DirFS(filepath.Dir(path)), filepath.Base(path), os.Getenv)
steps.expected: Loader returns overrides and error on empty secret

steps.action: Implement New(cfg *config.Config, log *slog.Logger) http.Handler building chi.NewRouter with a request-logging middleware using log.Info (method, path, status) and GET /healthz writing JSON {"status":"ok"} with Content-Type application/json

Parse -config flag (default configs/config.example.yaml), build slog.NewJSONHandler logger on stdout, call config.Load, then http.ListenAndServe(cfg.Server.Addr, server.New(cfg, logger)); on error log and os.Exit(1)

nodes.description: Add the player package with HMAC token Sign/Verify and the session handler setting a Secure HttpOnly cookie, and register the route.
acceptance_criteria: Session returns 201 with id and cookie
Token verifies with same secret

steps.action: Implement NewID() using crypto/rand 16 bytes hex-encoded; Sign(secret []byte, id string, issued time.Time) string returning base64.RawURLEncoding(id+"."+unix) + "." + base64url(HMAC-SHA256 of the first part); Verify(secret []byte, token string, now time.Time, ttl time.Duration) (string, error) splitting on '.', checking hmac.Equal, parsing issued unix, rejecting when now.Sub(issued) > ttl, returning the id; export ErrInvalidToken
steps.expected: Round trip returns id; tampering returns ErrInvalidToken

steps.action: Define Handler{Secret []byte; CookieName string; TTL time.Duration; Secure bool; Now func() time.Time}. CreateSession generates NewID, signs token, sets http.Cookie{Name, Value, Path '/', MaxAge int(TTL.Seconds()), HttpOnly true, Secure h.Secure, SameSite Lax} and writes 201 JSON {"id":id}
Construct player.Handler from cfg (Secret []byte(cfg.Auth.TokenSecret), CookieName, TTL, Secure cfg.Auth.CookieSecure, Now time.Now) and register r.Post("/api/v1/player/session", ph.CreateSession)
